main_text.p: 2. Refp. Remonft. Promiffio hæc fit toti po-Resp. Re-monstr. Apol.pulo:at promiffio gratiæ determinantis tantum *.17 p.164.paucis absolute electis fit,non toti populo quo-Eodem modo refpondetniam Ier.31.&Heb.8.fit domui Israelis & Iehudæ. Nam per utramq; domū notantur ii in quibus Suarez. l.3.cor & fpiritus vetus erat:in quibus cor non carneum,sed lapideū erat:per quos si notentur electi,tum nulli in populo tum erant,qui cor novū & carneum habebat, d. auxil. div.quo tempore hæc promissio fiebat: præter electos autem non fuerunt in populo, nisi reprobi: at nec reprobi habuerunt cor carneum, nec electi, quia alioqui id dari iis opus non fuisset: ergo nulli. R. 1. Merae conjecturae, & falsa omnia. Hæc promissio non fit toti populo ex intentione Dei, sed proponitur ecclesiae visibili, & ex intentione Dei fit & præstatur in solis electis: & do-mum veri Israelis & Iehudæ corde circumcisorum solos electos notare quis dubitaverit? Rom. 11. 26.27. Totus Israel servabitur: fit enim Ier.31.33. promissio iis in quibus Deus legem cordi insculpturus erat, & quorum peccata Deus.est remissurus, ita ut peccatorum eorum non fit amplius recordaturus & cap.36. Ezech. de ecclesia electorum planissime loquitur. 2. Deinde si fit toti populo ex intentione Dei, omnes & singuli aqua pura aspergetur,remissio-nem peccatorum consequentur, leipsos sufti-[?]dio habebunt propter peccata, & v.29. ab omnibus immunditiis liberabuntur, ac propinde à ponendo Deo vocanti obicem, quæ non est mediocris immunditia: quod abjur-

page.notes: Left margin notes read as printed: "Resp. Re-monstr. Apol."; "*.17 p.164." (the leading mark is doubtful); "Eodem modo refpondet"; "Suarez. l.3."; "d. auxil. div."; a further note near the start of the second group, "Grat. c.15. f.8.", was not transcribed because its position and reading are uncertain. "sufti-" in line 28 is doubtful. "circumcisorum" reads from a long-s form and is uncertain. The word "dum" at the foot is the catchword for the next page. The division of the paragraph at "R. 1. Merae" and at "2. Deinde" is uncertain: both numbers stand mid-line, so the whole text is kept as one paragraph.
